region.name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches
region.text: A narrow peninsula between the Gulf and Tampa Bay that packs in a walkable waterfront city, a string of barrier island beach towns and a few small bayside downtowns. Tampa's airport is close to all of it.

towns.name: Dunedin
towns.blurb: A walkable, laid back downtown near some of the Gulf's best island beaches.
towns.day: You walk downtown for coffee, take the ferry to Caladesi Island for the beach, and bike the Pinellas Trail home.
todo: A barrier island beach reached by ferry.
A long paved trail running right through downtown.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Clearwater Beach
towns.blurb: Soft white sand, a walkable beach strip and nightly sunset gatherings at Pier 60.
towns.day: You walk the beach at sunrise and join the crowd at Pier 60 for the sunset.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Gulfport
towns.watch: Flooding in low lying streets. Hit hard by Helene in 2024
towns.blurb: An artsy little waterfront town with a slow pace and a friendly main street.
towns.day: You wander the galleries on Beach Boulevard and catch live music by the water.
todo: Galleries and cafes leading down to the waterfront. The historic Casino Ballroom is closed for storm repairs.
pros: Small town feel near a big city
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Clearwater
towns.airport: Tampa (TPA), about 30 minutes, or St. Pete Clearwater (PIE)
towns.watch: Storm surge near the water, beach traffic
towns.blurb: The mainland city behind Clearwater Beach, with a rebuilt downtown waterfront and the sand a bridge away.
towns.day: You catch a concert at Coachman Park on the bluff, then bike the causeway to the beach.
todo: A downtown waterfront park with a big outdoor concert venue.
pros: Near a famous beach without beach prices
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Indian Rocks Beach
towns.airport: St. Pete Clearwater (PIE) or Tampa (TPA), about 40 minutes
towns.watch: Barrier island flooding. Hit by Helene in 2024
towns.blurb: A low key beach town of cottages and small condos, with public beach access at the end of nearly every street.
towns.day: You walk to the beach with a chair, walk home for lunch and walk back for the sunset.
todo: More than two dozen public accesses, many with a little free parking.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Madeira Beach
towns.airport: St. Pete Clearwater (PIE) or Tampa (TPA), about 40 minutes
towns.watch: Barrier island flooding. Hit by Helene in 2024
towns.blurb: Locals call it Mad Beach: a casual Gulf town built around the fishing boats and boardwalk at John's Pass.
towns.day: You watch the charter boats come in at John's Pass, then cross the street to the beach.
todo: A boardwalk of seafood spots, shops and fishing charters on the inlet.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: New Port Richey
towns.watch: Flooding along the river and coast
towns.blurb: A small river town with a 1920s downtown that has been adding breweries, restaurants and a restored theater.
towns.day: You kayak the Cotee River in the morning and walk Main Street for dinner.
todo: A riverfront park downtown with concerts and events.
cons: Not much of a beach nearby
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Safety Harbor
towns.blurb: A small town on Old Tampa Bay with oak shaded streets, a historic spa and a Main Street full of local shops.
towns.day: You walk the waterfront park and pier, then have dinner on Main Street without moving the car.
todo: Local restaurants and shops, with a street festival on the third Friday of the month.
pros: A walkable small town close to Tampa
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: St. Pete Beach
towns.airport: Tampa (TPA) or St. Pete Clearwater (PIE), about 35 minutes
towns.watch: Barrier island flooding. Hit by Helene in 2024
towns.blurb: A wide Gulf beach anchored by the pink Don CeSar hotel, with the old fishing village of Pass-a-Grille at its tip.
towns.day: You have breakfast in Pass-a-Grille, spend the day on the wide Gulf beach and stay for the sunset.
todo: A historic beach village with a sunset bell and no high rises.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: St. Petersburg
towns.airport: Tampa (TPA), about 25 to 35 minutes, or St. Pete Clearwater (PIE)
towns.watch: Flooding in low lying neighborhoods, rising prices
towns.blurb: A sunny waterfront city with a walkable downtown, the Dalí Museum, murals on every block and Gulf beaches 20 minutes away.
towns.day: You walk the waterfront parks to the Pier, wander the Saturday Morning Market and pick a brewery for the afternoon.
todo: A world class collection on the downtown waterfront.
pros: A big arts, food and music scene
A walkable downtown on the water
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Tarpon Springs
towns.watch: Flooding near the bayous and river. Helene's surge flooded the Sponge Docks in 2024
towns.blurb: A working sponge port with Greek bakeries and restaurants along the docks and bayous winding through town.
towns.day: You walk the Sponge Docks for coffee and pastry, watch the boats unload and drive to Fred Howard Park for the sunset.
todo: Sponge boats, restaurants and bakeries along Dodecanese Boulevard.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches

towns.name: Treasure Island
towns.airport: Tampa (TPA) or St. Pete Clearwater (PIE), about 35 minutes
towns.watch: Barrier island flooding. Hit by Helene in 2024
towns.blurb: A barrier island with one of the widest beaches on the Gulf.
towns.day: You cross a long stretch of sand to reach the water, and on Sundays you stay for the drum circle at sunset.
todo: A paved walkway about a mile long, running along the dunes.
pros: A huge beach that never feels crowded
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches
